C1322.title: Petya/NotPetya Leveraged LotL Tools for Mass Propagation
C1322.summary: The 2017 global Petya/NotPetya outbreak heavily exploited Living off the Land techniques. Attackers used Mimikatz to dump credentials from memory, then utilized stolen account credentials to remotely execute the malware across networks via PsExec and WMI command-line tools, achieving lateral movement.
